main.description: Create a record in the logged-in account's repo, at its PDS, and index it before answering. For the web, by its session cookie, from a page of the site; a service token is refused (the apps write to their own PDS, then call social.grain.sync.indexRecords).

record.description: The record. One without a $type is given the collection's.

errors.name: UnknownCollection
errors.description: grain does not index the collection.

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: The record does not fit its lexicon.

errors.name: ScopeMissingError
errors.description: The account's PDS granted the session less than the write needs.
